The same intelligence can create value at different points in the buying cycle. 01 VALUE HUNTING Find value hidden by fragmentation Find value hidden by fragmentation Spend is fragmented across sites, part numbers, and suppliers, and the savings sit in the gaps between them. Mages run category strategies, match equivalent materials across separate systems, aggregate demand, and turn your own pricing history into leverage before the next negotiation. Before purchase · category strategy · spend analysis · item identity · should-cost 02 VALUE PROTECTION Protect value during purchase Protect value during purchase Value leaves the business at the point of purchase, in the gap between what was contracted and what gets ordered. Mages check every requisition against existing contracts and prior purchases, flag the cheaper contracted supplier and terms, and apply your compliance controls before the PO issues. During purchase · purchasing controls · supplier routing · PR→PO · PO→AP 03 VALUE RECOVERY Enforce every supplier obligation Enforce every supplier obligation Terms get agreed once and then quietly stop being applied. Mages read contracts, invoices, and transaction history together, catching price deviations, missed rebates, unearned volume discounts, and weak supplier performance the moment they appear, with the evidence attached. After purchase · contract compliance · price deviations · recovery · audit AI agents at work across procurement AI agents at work across procurement Runs the whole job Magentic takes on a whole job and runs it end to end, reviewing spend and contracts, pulling in benchmarks, calculating the savings, and preparing and sending the supplier message. Find cheaper alternatives Magentic spots where an equivalent product costs far less, then shows exactly how much you would save by switching to it. Buy on the best terms Magentic catches purchases heading off-contract or above the agreed price, and points to the approved supplier and better terms before the order goes out. Recover leaked value Magentic scans years of orders and invoices to surface overpayments, missed rebates, and off-contract charges, shows exactly how much you can claim back, and then implements the best way to recover the leakage. Reads every contract Magentic reads your supplier agreements and pulls out the terms that matter, from pricing and obligations to liability caps, so nothing stays buried in a PDF. Built on your data Magentic connects your contracts, ERP, invoices, emails, and spreadsheets into one procurement data model, matching the same supplier or part across every system, language and format. Consolidate suppliers Magentic finds duplicate suppliers for the same spend and helps you consolidate them into one better deal. Find cheaper alternatives Magentic finds a cheaper equivalent and lines up the switch, so the saving gets captured, not just spotted. Runs the whole job Magentic takes a whole task from start to finish, from reviewing the spend to drafting and sending the supplier ask. Buy on the best terms Magentic checks each purchase, catches anything off-contract, and steers it to the approved supplier and price before the order goes out. Recover leaked value Magentic catches overpayments across years of orders and builds the claim to get the cash back. Reclaim with evidence Magentic works each recovery case end to end and assembles the evidence to reclaim the cash from the supplier. Reconcile against reality Magentic matches every order to what actually happened and resolves the discrepancies it finds. Reads every contract Magentic pulls the terms out of every supplier agreement and holds each purchase to them. Catch price breaches Magentic reviews thousands of items, catches every price breach, and takes the fix through to the supplier.
